units.zh: 梁書卷第二十 列傳第十四
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 20, Biographies 14
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 20, Biographies 14

units.zh: 劉季連 陳伯之
units.en: Liu Lijian; Chen Bozhi
units.literal: Liu Lijian; Chen Bozhi

units.zh: 劉季連字惠續，彭城人也。
units.en: Liu Lijian, styled Huixu, came from Pengcheng.
units.literal: Liu Lijian, styled Huixu, was a native of Pengcheng.

units.zh: 父思考，以宋高祖族弟顯於宋世，位至金紫光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Sikao, kin to Song Gaozu, shone in the Song age and rose to Grand Master of Splendid Virtue with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
units.literal: His father Sikao, as a cousin of Song's founding sovereign Gaozu, had been eminent in the Song age and rose to Grand Master of Splendid Virtue with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

units.zh: 季連有名譽，早歷清官。
units.en: Lijian was widely esteemed and early held clean posts.
units.literal: Lijian had a fine reputation and early passed through pure offices.

units.zh: 齊高帝受禪，悉誅宋室近屬，將及季連等，太宰褚淵素善之，固請乃免。
units.en: When Qi Gaozu took the throne he meant to kill every near branch of Song; Lijian was next, but Chu Yuan, who had long favored him, pleaded until he was spared.
units.literal: When Qi Gaozu accepted the abdication, he was set to slay all near kin of the Song house; Lijian's turn was coming, but the grand minister Chu Yuan, who had long favored him, pleaded hard and he was spared.

units.zh: 建元中，季連爲尚書左丞。
units.en: In Jianyuan he was Left Director in the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: In the Jianyuan era he was Left Director in the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 永明初，出爲江夏內史，累遷平南長沙內史，冠軍長史、廣陵太守，並行府州事。
units.en: At Yongming's opening he was Jiangxia interior governor, then Pingnan and Changsha, champion staff officer and Guangling prefect, all running his seat.
units.literal: At the opening of Yongming he went out as interior governor of Jiangxia, rose through interior governor of Pingnan and Changsha, champion staff officer and Guangling prefect, all while running his district seat.

units.zh: 入爲給事黃門侍郎，轉太子中庶子。
units.en: He entered as Yellow Gate attendant, then crown prince chief of staff.
units.literal: He entered as Gentleman Attendant of the Yellow Gate who presents matters, then became crown prince chief of staff.

units.zh: 建武中，又出爲平西蕭遙欣長史、南郡太守。
units.en: In Jianwu he again went out as staff officer to Pingxi general Xiao Yaoqin and Nanjun prefect.
units.literal: In the Jianwu era he again went out as staff officer to Pingxi general Xiao Yaoqin and prefect of Nanjun.

units.zh: 時明帝諸子幼弱，內親則仗遙欣兄弟，外親則倚后弟劉暄、內弟江祏。
units.en: The Ming Emperor's sons were still young; inside the palace he leaned on the Yaoqin brothers, outside on the empress's brother Liu Xuan and her brother-in-law Jiang Shi.
units.literal: At that time the Ming Emperor's sons were young and weak; for kin within the palace he relied on the Yaoqin brothers, for kin without on the empress's brother Liu Xuan and her brother-in-law Jiang Shi.

units.zh: 遙欣之鎮江陵也，意寄甚隆；
units.en: When Yaoqin held Jiangling, trust in him ran deep;
units.literal: When Yaoqin took his post at Jiangling his trust ran deep;

units.zh: 而遙欣至州，多招賓客，厚自封殖，明帝甚惡之。
units.en: but in the province he gathered guests and grew fat on graft, and the Ming Emperor came to hate him.
units.literal: but once in the province he drew in many guests and fattened himself on graft, and the Ming Emperor came to hate him.

units.zh: 季連族甥琅邪王會爲遙欣諮議參軍，美容貌，頗才辯，遙欣遇之甚厚。
units.en: Lijian's clan nephew Wang Hui of Langya was Yaoqin's advising staff officer—handsome and sharp-tongued; Yaoqin favored him.
units.literal: Lijian's clan nephew Wang Hui of Langya served as Yaoqin's advising staff officer—handsome, quick with words; Yaoqin favored him greatly.

units.zh: 會多所慠忽，於公座與遙欣競侮季連，季連憾之，乃密表明帝，稱遙欣有異迹。
units.en: Hui was insolent; before the assembly he and Yaoqin mocked Lijian together. Lijian nursed the grudge and secretly told the Ming Emperor that Yaoqin showed suspicious signs.
units.literal: Hui was often insolent; at a public session he vied with Yaoqin to mock Lijian, who bore a grudge and secretly reported to the Ming Emperor that Yaoqin showed suspicious conduct.

units.zh: 明帝納焉，乃以遙欣爲雍州刺史。
units.en: The emperor believed him and made Yaoqin Yongzhou inspector.
units.literal: The emperor took it in and made Yaoqin inspector of Yongzhou.

units.zh: 明帝心德季連，四年，以爲輔國將軍、益州刺史，令據遙欣上流。
units.en: Grateful to Lijian, in year four the emperor made him Supporting-the-State General and Yizhou inspector, set to hold the upper river against Yaoqin.
units.literal: The emperor was grateful to Lijian; in year four he made him Supporting-the-State General and inspector of Yizhou, ordering him to hold the upper reaches against Yaoqin.

units.zh: 季連父，宋世爲益州，貪鄙無政績，州人猶以義故，善待季連。
units.en: His father had held Yizhou in Song times, greedy and without merit, yet the people, for old friendship's sake, still treated Lijian kindly.
units.literal: Lijian's father in the Song age had held Yizhou, greedy and without good governance, yet the people, still for old friendship's sake, treated Lijian kindly.

units.zh: 季連下車，存問故老，撫納新舊，見父時故吏，皆對之流涕。
units.en: On taking office he asked after elders, comforted old and new ties, and wept with his father's former clerks.
units.literal: When Lijian stepped down from his carriage he inquired of elders, comforted old and new ties, and when he saw his father's former clerks he wept openly with them.

units.zh: 辟遂寧人龔愜爲府主簿。
units.en: He made Gong Yi of Suining his chief clerical secretary.
units.literal: He recruited Gong Yi of Suining as his chief clerical secretary.

units.zh: 愜，龔穎之孫，累世有學行，故引焉。
units.en: Yi was Gong Ying's grandson; learning and conduct ran in the line, so he was brought in.
units.literal: Yi was grandson of Gong Ying; for generations the house had learning and conduct, so he was brought in.

units.zh: 東昏卽位，永元元年，徵季連爲右衛將軍，道斷不至。
units.en: When Eastern Depravity took the throne, in Yongyuan year one Lijian was summoned as Right Guard General; the roads were cut and he never came.
units.literal: When Eastern Depravity took the throne, in the first year of Yongyuan, Lijian was summoned as Right Guard General but the roads were cut and he did not come.

units.zh: 季連聞東昏失德，京師多故，稍自驕矜。
units.en: Hearing Eastern Depravity's loss of virtue and the capital's many troubles, he grew proud.
units.literal: Hearing the capital racked with troubles because of Eastern Depravity's loss of virtue, he grew somewhat proud and arrogant.

units.zh: 本以文吏知名，性忌而褊狹，至是遂嚴愎酷狠，土人始懷怨望。
units.en: Famed as a man of letters, jealous and narrow by nature, he now turned harsh, obstinate, cruel, and fierce, and the land began to resent him.
units.literal: He had been known as a man of letters; nature jealous and narrow-minded—now he turned harsh, obstinate, cruel, and fierce, and the locals first nursed resentment.

units.zh: 其年九月，季連因聚會，發人丁五千人，聲以講武，遂遣中兵參軍宋買率之以襲中水。
units.en: That September, at a gathering, he levied five thousand men under cover of drill and sent middle army staff officer Song Mai to strike Zhongshui by surprise.
units.literal: That September, under pretext of a gathering, he levied five thousand men, claiming drill, and sent middle army staff officer Song Mai to lead them in surprise at Zhongshui.

units.zh: 穰人李託豫知之，設備守險，買與戰不利，還州，郡縣多叛亂矣。
units.en: Li Tuo of Rang learned beforehand, barred the passes, and Mai fought poorly and retreated; commanderies and counties rebelled everywhere.
units.literal: The people of Rang, Li Tuo, learned beforehand, barred the passes, and Mai fought poorly and retreated to the provincial seat; commanderies and counties rebelled far and wide.

units.zh: 是月，新城人趙續伯殺五城令，逐始平太守。
units.en: That month Zhao Xubo of Xincheng killed the magistrate of Wucheng and drove out Shiping's grand administrator.
units.literal: That month Zhao Xubo of Xincheng killed the magistrate of Wucheng and drove out the grand administrator of Shiping.

units.zh: 十月，晉原人樂寶稱、李難當殺其太守，寶稱自號南秦州刺史，難當益州刺史。
units.en: In the tenth month Le Baocheng and Li Nandang of Jinyuan killed their grand administrator; Baocheng styled himself Southern Qin inspector, Nandang Yizhou inspector.
units.literal: In the tenth month Le Baocheng and Li Nandang of Jinyuan killed their grand administrator; Baocheng styled himself inspector of Southern Qin, Nandang inspector of Yizhou.

units.zh: 十二月，季連遣參軍崔茂祖率衆二千討之，齎三日糧。
units.en: In the twelfth month Lijian sent staff officer Cui Maozu with two thousand to suppress them, with three days' grain.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Lijian sent staff officer Cui Maozu with two thousand to suppress them, with three days' provisions.

units.zh: 值歲大寒，羣賊相聚，伐樹塞路，軍人水火無所得，大敗而還，死者十七八。
units.en: The year was bitter cold; rebels felled trees to block the road; the army found no fire or water, was routed, and seven or eight in ten died.
units.literal: The year was bitterly cold; rebels gathered to fell trees and block the roads; the army found neither fire nor water, was routed, and seven or eight in ten died.

units.zh: 明年正月，新城人帛養逐遂寧太守譙希淵。
units.en: Next first month Bo Yang of Xincheng drove out Suining prefect Qiao Xiyuan.
units.literal: The next first month the people of Xincheng, Bo Yang, drove out Suining prefect Qiao Xiyuan.

units.zh: 三月，巴西人雍道晞率羣賊萬餘逼巴西，去郡數里，道晞稱鎮西將軍，號建義。
units.en: In the third month Yong Daoxi of Baxi led more than ten thousand rebels within a few li of the seat, styled himself Pacifying-the-West General, and raised the banner of Righteous Purpose.
units.literal: In the third month Yong Daoxi of Baxi led more than ten thousand rebels against Baxi, a few li from the commandery seat; he styled himself Pacifying-the-West General and proclaimed the army of Righteous Purpose.

units.zh: 巴西太守魯休烈與涪令李膺嬰城自守，季連遣中兵參軍李奉伯率衆五千救之。
units.en: Baxi prefect Lu Xiulie and Fuling magistrate Li Ying shut the walls; Lijian sent middle army staff officer Li Fengbo with five thousand to rescue them.
units.literal: Baxi prefect Lu Xiulie and Fuling magistrate Li Ying shut the city and held firm; Lijian sent middle army staff officer Li Fengbo with five thousand to rescue them.

units.zh: 奉伯至，與郡兵破擒道晞，斬之涪市。
units.en: Fengbo arrived, joined the commandery troops, broke Daoxi, and beheaded him in the Fuling market.
units.literal: Fengbo arrived, joined the commandery troops, broke and captured Daoxi, and beheaded him in the Fuling market.

units.zh: 奉伯因獨進巴西之東鄉討餘賊。
units.en: Fengbo then pressed alone into Baxi's eastern villages to hunt the remainder.
units.literal: Fengbo then pressed alone into the eastern villages of Baxi to hunt down the remainder.

units.zh: 李膺止之曰：「卒惰將驕，乘勝履險，非良策也。
units.en: Li Ying stopped him: "Troops are lax and the general arrogant; to press an advantage over steep ground is no sound plan.
units.literal: Li Ying stopped him: "The troops are lax and the general arrogant; to press an advantage over steep ground is no sound plan.

units.zh: 不如小緩，更思後計。」
units.en: Better slow a little and weigh what comes next."
units.literal: Better slow a little and weigh the next move."

units.zh: 奉伯不納，悉衆入山，大敗而出，遂奔還州。
units.en: Fengbo would not listen, took the whole force into the hills, was routed coming out, and fled to the provincial seat.
units.literal: Fengbo would not heed him, took the whole force into the hills, was routed coming out, and fled back to the provincial seat.

units.zh: 六月，江陽人程延期反，殺太守何法藏。
units.en: In the sixth month Cheng Yanqi of Jiangyang rebelled and killed prefect He Fazang.
units.literal: In the sixth month Cheng Yanqi of Jiangyang rebelled and killed prefect He Fazang.

units.zh: 魯休烈懼不自保，奔投巴東相蕭慧訓。
units.en: Lu Xiulie, fearing he could not hold, fled to Badong adjutant Xiao Huixun for refuge.
units.literal: Lu Xiulie, fearing he could not hold, fled to seek refuge with Badong adjutant Xiao Huixun.

units.zh: 十月，巴西人趙續伯又反，有衆二萬，出廣漢，乘佛輿，以五彩裹青石，誑百姓云：「天與我玉印，當王蜀。」
units.en: In the tenth month Zhao Xubo of Baxi rebelled again with twenty thousand men, marching from Guanghan in a Buddha-cart, blue stone wrapped in five colors, telling the people, "Heaven gave me a jade seal—I shall be king in Shu."
units.literal: In the tenth month Zhao Xubo of Baxi rebelled again with twenty thousand men, marching from Guanghan, riding a Buddha-cart, wrapping blue stone in five-colored cloth, and telling the people: "Heaven has given me a jade seal—I shall be king in Shu."

units.zh: 愚人從之者甚衆。
units.en: Fools followed in great numbers.
units.literal: Fools followed him in great numbers.

units.zh: 季連進討之，遣長史趙越常前驅。
units.en: Lijian advanced to punish him and sent chief clerk Zhao Yuechang ahead.
units.literal: Lijian advanced to punish him and sent his chief clerk Zhao Yuechang as vanguard.

units.zh: 兵敗，季連復遣李奉伯由涪路討之。
units.en: The army was beaten; Lijian again sent Li Fengbo by the Fuling road.
units.literal: The army was defeated; Lijian again sent Li Fengbo by the Fuling road.

units.zh: 奉伯別軍自潺亭與大軍會於城，進攻其柵，大破之。
units.en: Fengbo's detached column came from Chanting Pavilion, joined the main force at the city, stormed the palisade, and won a great victory.
units.literal: Fengbo's detached column came from Chanting Pavilion and joined the main force outside the city, stormed the palisade, and won a great victory.

units.zh: 時會稽人石文安字守休，隱居鄉里，專行禮讓，代季連爲尚書左丞，出爲江夏內史，又代季連入爲御史中丞，與季連相善。
units.en: At that time Shi Wen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion practicing courtesy, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, then replaced him again as Censor-in-Chief—and he and Lijian were friends.
units.literal: At that time Shiwen'an of Kuaiji, styled Shouxiu, lived in seclusion in his district practicing courtesy and deference, had replaced Lijian as Left Director, gone out as Jiangxia interior governor, and again replaced Lijian as Censor-in-Chief—he and Lijian were on good terms.

units.zh: 子仲淵字欽回，聞義師起，率鄉人以應高祖。
units.en: His son Zhongyuan, styled Qinhui, hearing the Righteous Army had risen, led the district to answer Gaozu.
units.literal: His son Zhongyuan, styled Qinhui, hearing the Righteous Army had risen, led the district men to answer Gaozu.

units.zh: 天監初，拜郢州別駕，從高祖平京邑。
units.en: At Tianjian's opening he was Yingzhou Bieyu and followed Gaozu to pacify the capital.
units.literal: At the start of Tianjian he was made Bieyu of Yingzhou and followed Gaozu to pacify the capital.

units.zh: 明年春，遣左右陳建孫送季連弟通直郎子淵及季連二子使蜀，喻旨慰勞。
units.en: Next spring Gaozu sent close attendant Chen Jiansun to bring Lijian's younger brother Tongzhilang Ziyuan and Lijian's two sons into Shu with words of comfort.
units.literal: The next spring Gaozu sent his close attendant Chen Jiansun to convey Lijian's younger brother Tongzhilang Ziyuan and Lijian's two sons into Shu with imperial words of comfort.

units.zh: 季連受命，飭還裝。
units.en: Lijian accepted the charge and prepared to return.
units.literal: Lijian accepted the charge and prepared to return.

units.zh: 高祖以西臺將鄧元起爲益州刺史。
units.en: Gaozu made western headquarters general Deng Yuanqi Yizhou inspector.
units.literal: Gaozu made western headquarters general Deng Yuanqi inspector of Yizhou.

units.zh: 元起，南郡人。
units.en: Yuanqi came from Nanjun commandery.
units.literal: Yuanqi was a man of Nanjun commandery.

units.zh: 季連爲南郡之時，素薄元起。
units.en: When Lijian had held Nanjun he had always looked down on Yuanqi.
units.literal: When Lijian had held Nanjun he had always looked down on Yuanqi.

units.zh: 典簽朱道琛者，嘗爲季連府都錄，無賴小人，有罪，季連欲殺之，逃叛以免。
units.en: Chief controller Zhu Daochen had once been head recorder in Lijian's office—a worthless rogue with crimes; Lijian meant to kill him but he fled and lived.
units.literal: Chief controller Zhu Daochen had once been head recorder in Lijian's office—a worthless rogue with crimes; Lijian meant to kill him but he fled and lived.

units.zh: 至是說元起曰：「益州亂離已久，公私府庫必多秏失，劉益州臨歸空竭，豈辦復能遠遣候遞。
units.en: Now he told Yuanqi, "Yizhou has been torn apart for years; public and private treasuries must be drained. When Inspector Liu leaves he will empty everything—how could he still send escorts from afar?
units.literal: Now he told Yuanqi: "Yizhou has been in disorder long; public and private treasuries must be drained. When Inspector Liu leaves he will empty everything—how could he still send escorts far away?

units.zh: 道琛請先使檢校，緣路奉迎；
units.en: Let me go first to inspect and along the road pay court and welcome you;
units.literal: Let me first go to inspect, and along the road pay court and welcome you;

units.zh: 不然，萬里資糧，未易可得。」
units.en: otherwise supplies for ten thousand li will not come easy."
units.literal: otherwise ten thousand li of supplies will not be easy to obtain."

units.zh: 元起許之。
units.en: Yuanqi agreed.
units.literal: Yuanqi agreed.

units.zh: 道琛旣至，言語不恭，又歷造府州人士，見器物輒奪之，有不獲者，語曰：「會當屬人，何須苦惜。」
units.en: Once Daochen arrived his speech was rude; he went office to office among the district's men and seized whatever he saw, saying when refused, "Soon it will belong to someone else—why cling so hard?"
units.literal: Once Daochen arrived his speech was disrespectful; he went from office to office among the district's men, and wherever he saw goods he seized them, saying when refused: "Soon it will belong to someone else—why cling so hard?"

units.zh: 於是軍府大懼，謂元起至必誅季連，禍及黨與，競言之於季連。
units.en: The military prefecture was terrified, saying when Yuanqi came he would punish Lijian and drag down everyone linked with him; they rushed to tell Lijian.
units.literal: The military prefecture was terrified, saying when Yuanqi came he would surely punish Lijian and bring disaster on all linked with him; they rushed to tell Lijian.

units.zh: 季連亦以爲然；
units.en: Lijian believed it too;
units.literal: Lijian believed it too;

units.zh: 又惡昔之不禮元起也，益憤懣。
units.en: and he hated his old rudeness to Yuanqi, which deepened his rage.
units.literal: and he hated his old rudeness to Yuanqi, which deepened his rage.

units.zh: 司馬朱士略說季連，求爲巴西郡，留三子爲質，季連許之。
units.en: Marshal Zhu Shilve urged Lijian to ask for Baxi commandery and leave three sons as hostages; Lijian agreed.
units.literal: Marshal Zhu Shilve urged Lijian to ask for Baxi commandery, leaving three sons as hostages; Lijian agreed.

units.zh: 頃之，季連遂召佐史，矯稱齊宣德皇后令，聚兵復反，收朱道琛殺之。
units.en: Before long Lijian summoned his clerks, forged an edict in the name of Qi's Virtuous-Pacifying empress dowager, gathered troops and rebelled again, seized Zhu Daochen and killed him.
units.literal: Before long Lijian summoned his clerks, forged an edict in the name of Qi's Virtuous-Pacifying empress dowager, gathered troops and rebelled again, seized Zhu Daochen and killed him.

units.zh: 書報朱士略，兼召李膺。
units.en: He wrote Zhu Shilve and also summoned Li Ying.
units.literal: He wrote to Zhu Shilve and also summoned Li Ying.

units.zh: 膺、士略並不受使。
units.en: Ying and Shilve both refused the summons.
units.literal: Ying and Shilve both refused the summons.

units.zh: 使歸，元起收兵于巴西以待之，季連誅士略三子。
units.en: When the messengers returned, Yuanqi gathered troops in Baxi to wait; Lijian executed Shilve's three sons.
units.literal: When the messengers returned, Yuanqi gathered troops in Baxi to wait; Lijian executed Shilve's three sons.

units.zh: 天監元年六月，元起至巴西，季連遣其將李奉伯等拒戰。
units.en: In the sixth month of Tianjian year one Yuanqi reached Baxi; Lijian sent Li Fengbo and others to fight.
units.literal: In the sixth month of Tianjian year one Yuanqi reached Baxi; Lijian sent his generals Li Fengbo and others to fight.

units.zh: 兵交，互有得失，久之，奉伯乃敗退還成都。
units.en: Battle swayed back and forth; after a long while Fengbo was beaten back to Chengdu.
units.literal: Battle swayed back and forth; after a long while Fengbo was beaten back to Chengdu.

units.zh: 季連驅略居人，閉城固守。
units.en: Lijian drove out the inhabitants, shut the city, and held firm.
units.literal: Lijian drove out the inhabitants, shut the city, and held firm.

units.zh: 元起稍進圍之。
units.en: Yuanqi slowly advanced and besieged him.
units.literal: Yuanqi slowly advanced and besieged him.

units.zh: 是冬，季連城局參軍江希之等謀以城降，不果，季連誅之。
units.en: That winter staff officer Jiang Xizhi and others plotted to yield the city but failed; Lijian executed them.
units.literal: That winter staff officer Jiang Xizhi and others plotted to yield the city but failed; Lijian executed them.

units.zh: 蜀中喪亂已二年矣，城中食盡，升米三千，亦無所糴，餓死者相枕。
units.en: Shu had known turmoil two years; food in the city was gone—a sheng of rice cost three thousand cash and could not be bought; the dead lay atop one another from hunger.
units.literal: Shu had known turmoil two years; food in the city was gone—a sheng of rice cost three thousand cash yet could not be bought; the dead lay atop one another from hunger.

units.zh: 其無親黨者，又殺而食之。
units.en: Those without kin were killed and eaten.
units.literal: Those without kin were killed and eaten.

units.zh: 季連食粥累月，饑窘無計。
units.en: Lijian ate gruel for months, hunger and straits without plan.
units.literal: Lijian ate gruel for months, hunger and straits without plan.

units.zh: 二年正月，高祖遣主書趙景悅宣詔降季連，季連肉袒請罪。
units.en: In year two's first month Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.
units.literal: In the first month of year two Gaozu sent chief secretary Zhao Jingyue to announce an edict accepting Lijian's surrender; Lijian bared his torso and begged pardon.

units.zh: 元起遷季連於城外，俄而造焉，待之以禮。
units.en: Yuanqi moved Lijian outside the walls and soon came to visit, treating him with courtesy.
units.literal: Yuanqi moved Lijian outside the walls and soon came to visit, treating him with courtesy.

units.zh: 季連謝曰：「早知如此，豈有前日之事。」
units.en: Lijian said, "Had I known it would come to this, there would never have been what happened before."
units.literal: Lijian said: "Had I known it would come to this, there would never have been what happened before."

units.zh: 元起誅李奉伯幷諸渠帥，送季連還京師。
units.en: Yuanqi executed Li Fengbo and the other ringleaders and sent Lijian back to the capital.
units.literal: Yuanqi executed Li Fengbo and the other ringleaders and sent Lijian back to the capital.

units.zh: 季連將發，人莫之視，惟龔愜送焉。
units.en: As Lijian was about to set out, none would look at him; only Gong Yi saw him off.
units.literal: As Lijian was about to set out, none would look at him; only Gong Yi saw him off.

units.zh: 初，元起在道，懼事不集，無以爲賞，士之至者，皆許以辟命，於是受別駕、治中檄者，將二千人。
units.en: Earlier, on the road Yuanqi had feared failure and lacked rewards; to every officer who came he promised a commission—thus nearly two thousand held writs as deputy inspector or chief administrator.
units.literal: Earlier, while Yuanqi was on the road he had feared failure and lacked rewards; to every officer who came he promised a commission—thus nearly two thousand held writs as deputy inspector or chief administrator.

units.zh: 季連旣至，詣闕謝，高祖引見之。
units.en: When Lijian arrived he went to the palace to give thanks; Gaozu received him.
units.literal: When Lijian arrived he went to the palace to give thanks; Gaozu received him.

units.zh: 季連自東掖門入，數步一稽顙，以至高祖前。
units.en: Lijian entered by the East Flank Gate, kowtowing every few steps until he stood before Gaozu.
units.literal: Lijian entered by the East Flank Gate, kowtowing every few steps until he stood before Gaozu.

units.zh: 高祖笑謂曰：「卿欲慕劉備而曾不及公孫述，豈無臥龍之臣乎。」
units.en: Gaozu laughed and said, "You wished to rival Liu Bei yet could not even match Gongsun Shu—had you no Wolong at your side?"
units.literal: Gaozu laughed and said: "You wished to rival Liu Bei yet could not even match Gongsun Shu—had you no Wolong at your side?"

units.zh: 季連復稽顙謝。
units.en: Lijian kowtowed again in thanks.
units.literal: Lijian kowtowed again in thanks.

units.zh: 赦爲庶人。
units.en: He was pardoned to commoner status.
units.literal: He was pardoned to commoner status.

units.zh: 四年正月，因出建陽門，爲蜀人藺道恭所殺。
units.en: In year four's first month, going out the Jianyang Gate, he was killed by the Shu man Lan Daogong.
units.literal: In the first month of year four, going out the Jianyang Gate, he was killed by the Shu man Lan Daogong.

units.zh: 季連在蜀，殺道恭父，道恭出亡，至是而報復焉。
units.en: In Shu Lijian had killed Daogong's father; Daogong had fled and now took revenge.
units.literal: In Shu Lijian had killed Daogong's father; Daogong fled and now took revenge.

units.zh: 陳伯之，濟陰睢陵人也。
units.en: Chen Bozhi came from Suiling in Jiyin.
units.literal: Chen Bozhi was a native of Suiling in Jiyin.

units.zh: 幼有膂力。
units.en: From boyhood he had brute strength.
units.literal: From boyhood he had brute strength.

units.zh: 年十三四，好著獺皮冠，帶刺刀，候伺鄰里稻熟，輒偷刈之。
units.en: At thirteen or fourteen he loved an otter-skin cap and a barbed blade, watching until the neighbor's rice ripened, then stealing the harvest.
units.literal: At thirteen or fourteen he loved to wear an otter-skin cap and carry a barbed blade, watching until the neighbor's rice ripened, then stealing the harvest.

units.zh: 嘗爲田主所見，呵之云：「楚子莫動！」
units.en: Once a farmer caught him and shouted, "Chu boy, don't move!"
units.literal: Once a farmer caught him and shouted: "Chu boy, don't move!"

units.zh: 伯之謂田主曰：「君稻幸多，一擔何苦？」
units.en: Bozhi told the farmer, "Your rice is plentiful—what harm is one load?"
units.literal: Bozhi told the farmer: "Your rice is plentiful—what harm is one load?"

units.zh: 田主將執之，伯之因杖刀而進，將刺之，曰：「楚子定何如！」
units.en: When the farmer meant to seize him, Bozhi raised his blade and advanced to stab him, crying, "What can you do to this Chu boy!"
units.literal: When the farmer meant to seize him, Bozhi raised his blade and advanced to stab him, crying: "What can you do to this Chu boy!"

units.zh: 田主皆反走，伯之徐擔稻而歸。
units.en: The farmer fled; Bozhi slowly shouldered the rice and went home.
units.literal: The farmer fled; Bozhi slowly shouldered the rice and went home.

units.zh: 及年長，在鐘離數爲劫盜，嘗授面覘人船，船人斫之，獲其左耳。
units.en: Grown, in Zhongli he robbed again and again; once he masked his face to spy on a boat and the boatmen cut him—they took his left ear.
units.literal: Grown, in Zhongli he robbed again and again; once he masked his face to spy on a boat and the boatmen cut him—they took his left ear.

units.zh: 後隨鄉人車騎將軍王廣之，廣之愛其勇，每夜臥下榻，征伐嘗自隨。
units.en: Later he followed his townsman chariot-and-cavalry general Wang Guangzhi, who loved his courage and let him sleep below his couch at night; on campaigns he always went along.
units.literal: Later he followed his townsman the chariot-and-cavalry general Wang Guangzhi, who loved his courage and let him sleep below his couch at night; on campaigns he always went along.

units.zh: 齊安陸王子敬爲南兗州，頗持兵自衛。
units.en: Qi Prince of Anlu Zijing held Southern Yanzhou and kept many troops for self-defense.
units.literal: Qi Prince of Anlu Zijing held Southern Yanzhou and kept many troops about him for self-defense.

units.zh: 明帝遣廣之討子敬，廣之至歐陽，遣伯之先驅，因城開，獨入斬子敬。
units.en: The Ming Emperor sent Guangzhi to punish Zijing; at Ouyang Guangzhi sent Bozhi ahead, and when the gates opened Bozhi went in alone and beheaded Zijing.
units.literal: The Ming Emperor sent Guangzhi to punish Zijing; reaching Ouyang, Guangzhi sent Bozhi ahead, and when the gates opened Bozhi went in alone and beheaded Zijing.

units.zh: 又頻有戰功，以勳累遷爲冠軍將軍、驃騎司馬，封魚復縣伯，邑五百戶。
units.en: He won merit again and again, rose by battle honors to Champion General and Rapid Cavalry Marshal, and was enfeoffed Baron of Yufu with five hundred households.
units.literal: He won merit again and again, rose by battle honors to Champion General and Rapid Cavalry Marshal, and was enfeoffed Baron of Yufu with five hundred households.

units.zh: 義師起，東昏假伯之節、督前驅諸軍事、豫州刺史，將軍如故。
units.en: When the righteous army rose, Dong Hun lent Bozhi his staff, named him overseer of the vanguard, and inspector of Yuzhou; his rank stayed the same.
units.literal: When the righteous army rose, Dong Hun lent Chen Bozhi his staff, made him overseer of the vanguard hosts, and inspector of Yuzhou; his generalship stood as before.

units.zh: 尋轉江州，據尋陽以拒義軍。
units.en: Soon he took Jiangzhou and held Xunyang against the righteous army.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Jiangzhou and held Xunyang to block the righteous army.

units.zh: 郢城平，高祖得伯之幢主蘇隆之，使說伯之， 卽以爲安東將軍、江州刺史。
units.en: When Ying fell, Gaozu took Bozhi's banner-master Su Longzhi to persuade him; Bozhi was named Pacifies-the-East general and Jiangzhou inspector.
units.literal: When Ying city fell, Gaozu seized Bozhi's banner-master Su Longzhi and sent him to win Bozhi over; at once Bozhi was made Pacifies-the-East General and inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 伯之雖受命，猶懷兩端，偽云「大軍未須便下」。
units.en: Bozhi took the post but still hedged, claiming, "The great army need not march down yet."
units.literal: Though Bozhi accepted the commission, he still wavered between two sides and pretended, saying, "The great army need not advance yet."

units.zh: 高祖謂諸將曰：「伯之此答，其心未定，及其猶豫，宜逼之。」
units.en: Gaozu told the generals, "That answer shows Bozhi's heart is not fixed; while he still wavers, press him."
units.literal: Gaozu told the generals, "From this answer Bozhi's heart is unsettled; while he still hesitates, we should press him."

units.zh: 衆軍遂次尋陽，伯之退保南湖，然後歸附。
units.en: The armies halted at Xunyang; Bozhi withdrew to South Lake, then came over.
units.literal: The hosts then halted at Xunyang; Bozhi fell back to guard South Lake, and only then submitted.

units.zh: 進號鎮南將軍，與衆俱下。
units.en: He was raised to Pacifies-the-South general and went down with the armies.
units.literal: He was advanced to Pacifies-the-South General and marched down with the host.

units.zh: 伯之頓籬門，尋進西明門。
units.en: Bozhi camped at Fence Gate, then entered West Bright Gate.
units.literal: Bozhi encamped at Fence Gate, then soon entered West Bright Gate.

units.zh: 建康城未平，每降人出，伯之輒喚與耳語。
units.en: While Jiankang still held out, each time a defector emerged Bozhi would pull him aside and whisper.
units.literal: While Jiankang was not yet pacified, whenever a defector came out Bozhi would call him aside and speak into his ear.

units.zh: 高祖恐其復懷翻覆，密語伯之曰：「聞城中甚忿卿舉江州降，欲遣刺客中卿，宜以爲慮。」
units.en: Gaozu feared a fresh betrayal and told him privately, "I hear the city is enraged that you surrendered Jiangzhou; they will send assassins—take care."
units.literal: Gaozu feared he might turn again and spoke to him in secret, saying, "I hear the city is furious that you raised Jiangzhou and surrendered; they mean to send assassins against you—you should take thought for that."

units.zh: 伯之未之信。
units.en: Bozhi did not believe him.
units.literal: Bozhi did not believe it.

units.zh: 會東昏將鄭伯倫降，高祖使過伯之，謂曰：「城中甚忿卿，欲遣信誘卿以封賞。
units.en: When Dong Hun's general Zheng Bolun came over, Gaozu sent him to Bozhi, saying, "The city is furious with you and will try to lure you back with honors.
units.literal: Then Dong Hun's general Zheng Bolun surrendered; Gaozu sent him past Bozhi with the words, "The city is very angry with you and means to lure you back with promises of rank and reward.

units.zh: 須卿復降，當生割卿手腳；
units.en: If you yield again they will cut off your hands and feet while you live;
units.literal: If you surrender again they will flay you alive, limb by limb;

units.zh: 卿若不降，復欲遣刺客殺卿。
units.en: if you refuse, they will send assassins after you.
units.literal: if you do not surrender, they will again send assassins to kill you.

units.zh: 宜深爲備。」
units.en: Guard yourself well."
units.literal: You must guard yourself deeply."

units.zh: 伯之懼，自是無異志矣。
units.en: Bozhi was afraid, and from then on he held no second thought.
units.literal: Bozhi was afraid; from then on he had no second thought.

units.zh: 力戰有功。
units.en: He fought fiercely and earned merit.
units.literal: He fought hard and won merit.

units.zh: 城平，進號征南將軍，封豊城縣公，邑二千戶，遣還之鎮。
units.en: When the city fell he became Campaigns-the-South general, duke of Fengcheng with two thousand households, and returned to his post.
units.literal: When the city fell he was advanced to Campaigns-the-South General, enfeoffed as Duke of Fengcheng with two thousand households, and sent back to his command.

units.zh: 伯之不識書，及還江州，得文牒辭訟，惟作大諾而已。
units.en: Illiterate, back in Jiangzhou he would roar assent at every writ and suit.
units.literal: Bozhi could not read; back in Jiangzhou, when he received documents and lawsuits he would only bellow assent.

units.zh: 有事，典籤傳口語，與奪決於主者。
units.en: Matters were settled by whoever held sway while recorders relayed orders by mouth.
units.literal: When business arose, the recorders passed word by mouth and right and wrong were settled by whoever held sway.

units.zh: 伯之與豫章人鄧繕、永興人戴永忠並有舊，繕經藏伯之息英免禍，伯之尤德之。
units.en: He was old friends with Deng Shan of Yuzhang and Dai Yongzhong of Yongxing; Shan had once hidden his son Ying from harm, and Bozhi owed him deeply.
units.literal: Bozhi was old friends with Deng Shan of Yuzhang and Dai Yongzhong of Yongxing; Shan had once hidden Bozhi's son Ying and saved him from harm, and Bozhi was deeply obliged.

units.zh: 及在州，用繕爲別駕，永忠記室參軍。
units.en: In the province he made Shan vice-inspector and Yongzhong his recorder.
units.literal: In the province he made Shan vice-inspector and Yongzhong recorder on his staff.

units.zh: 河南褚緭，京師之薄行者，齊末爲揚州西曹，遇亂居閭里；
units.en: Chu Wei of Henan was a rake of the capital; at Qi's end he was Yangzhou western staff officer and, when chaos came, stayed in his lane;
units.literal: Chu Wei of Henan was a loose man of the capital; at the end of Qi he was western staff officer of Yangzhou and, when turmoil came, lived in his lane;

units.zh: 而輕薄互能自致，惟緭獨不達。
units.en: while other rakes still found their way up, only Wei could not.
units.literal: while other light fellows could still advance themselves, only Wei failed to rise.

units.zh: 高祖卽位，緭頻造尚書范雲，雲不好緭，堅距之。
units.en: After Gaozu took the throne Wei often visited Fan Yun, minister of personnel; Yun disliked him and kept him out.
units.literal: After Gaozu took the throne Wei often called on the Minister of Personnel Fan Yun; Yun disliked him and firmly shut him out.

units.zh: 緭益怒，私語所知曰：「建武以後，草澤底下，悉化成貴人，吾何罪而見棄。
units.en: Wei grew furious and whispered to friends, "Since Jianwu every nobody has become a lord—what is my crime that I am thrown away?
units.literal: Wei grew angrier and told those he knew in private, "Since Jianwu, every man from the grass roots has turned into a noble—what crime is mine that I am cast aside?

units.zh: 今天下草創，饑饉不已，喪亂未可知。
units.en: The realm is new, famine unending, and no one knows whether the turmoil will end.
units.literal: The realm is newly founded, famine does not cease, and whether chaos will end is still unknown.

units.zh: 陳伯之擁強兵在江州，非代來臣，有自疑意；
units.en: Chen Bozhi holds Jiangzhou with a strong host; he is no hereditary minister and nurses doubts;
units.literal: Chen Bozhi holds strong troops in Jiangzhou; he is no minister of long descent and bears private doubts;

units.zh: 且熒惑守南斗，詎非爲我出。
units.en: and the Sparkling One stands in the Southern Dipper—surely it moves for me.
units.literal: and the Sparkling One guards the Southern Dipper—surely it rises for me.

units.zh: 今者一行，事若無成，入魏，何遽減作河南郡。」
units.en: If this venture fails, I enter Wei—why not become governor of Henan at once?"
units.literal: If this one venture fails, I need only go to Wei—why should I not at once be made governor of Henan?"

units.zh: 於是遂投伯之書佐王思穆，事之，大見親狎。
units.en: So he joined Bozhi's clerk Wang Simu, served him closely, and won great favor.
units.literal: So he threw in his lot with Bozhi's clerk Wang Simu, served him, and was soon treated with great intimacy.

units.zh: 及伯之鄉人朱龍符爲長流參軍，並乘伯之愚闇，恣行姦險，刑政通塞，悉共專之。
units.en: Zhu Longfu, Bozhi's townsman, became senior recorder; he and Wei preyed on Bozhi's ignorance and ran the province by fraud and force.
units.literal: When Bozhi's townsman Zhu Longfu became senior recorder, together with Wei they rode Bozhi's dullness and ran wild with treachery; punishments and policy passed or failed as they alone willed.

units.zh: 伯之子虎牙，時爲直閤將軍，高祖手疏龍符罪，親付虎牙，虎牙封示伯之；
units.en: Bozhi's son Huya was Direct Attendant general; Gaozu wrote Longfu's crimes in his own hand for Huya, and Huya showed his father;
units.literal: Bozhi's son Huya was then Direct Attendant General; Gaozu wrote Longfu's crimes in his own hand and gave the note to Huya; Huya showed it to Bozhi;

units.zh: 高祖又遣代江州別駕鄧繕，伯之並不受命。
units.en: Gaozu also sent a replacement for vice-inspector Deng Shan; Bozhi refused both.
units.literal: Gaozu also sent a man to replace Jiangzhou vice-inspector Deng Shan, and Bozhi refused both orders.

units.zh: 答高祖曰：「龍符驍勇健兒，鄧繕事有績效，臺所遣別駕，請以爲治中。」
units.en: He answered Gaozu, "Longfu is a bold fighter; Deng Shan has done real work. Let the court's vice-inspector serve as chief clerk instead."
units.literal: He answered Gaozu, "Longfu is a fierce and valiant fighter; Deng Shan has real achievements. As for the vice-inspector the court sends, please make him chief clerk instead."

units.zh: 繕於是日夜說伯之云：「臺家府庫空竭，復無器仗，三倉無米，東境饑流，此萬代一時也，機不可失。」
units.en: Shan urged him day and night, "The court's treasuries are bare, its arsenals empty, the granaries dry, the east a river of refugees—this moment will not come again."
units.literal: Shan then night and day urged Bozhi, saying, "The court's storehouses are empty and there are no weapons; the three granaries have no grain; the eastern lands are starving wanderers—this is a chance that comes once in ten thousand generations; the moment must not be lost."

units.zh: 緭、永忠等每贊成之。
units.en: Wei, Yongzhong, and the rest kept urging him on.
units.literal: Wei, Yongzhong, and the rest kept seconding him.

units.zh: 伯之謂繕：「今段啓卿，若復不得，便與卿共下使反。」
units.en: Bozhi told Shan, "This time I back you; if I fail again, I march with you against the court."
units.literal: Bozhi told Shan, "This time I raise you up; if I still fail, I will go down with you and rebel."

units.zh: 高祖敕部內一郡處繕，伯之於是集府州佐史謂曰：「奉齊建安王教，率江北義勇十萬，已次六合，見使以江州見力運糧速下。
units.en: Gaozu seized Shan in one commandery; Bozhi gathered his staff and said, "By Qi's Prince of Jian'an I lead a hundred thousand northern volunteers at Liuhe; an envoy orders Jiangzhou to haul grain south at once.
units.literal: Gaozu ordered one commandery in the circuit to take Shan in; Bozhi then gathered the province's officers and clerks and said, "By the Prince of Jian'an's command of Qi I lead a hundred thousand righteous men of the north; they have halted at Liuhe. An envoy orders the Jiangzhou levies to haul grain south at once.

units.zh: 我荷明帝厚恩，誓死以報。
units.en: I owe Mingdi a great debt and swear to repay it with my life.
units.literal: I owe Emperor Ming a deep grace and swear to die repaying it.

units.zh: 今便纂嚴備辦。」
units.en: We arm and prepare now."
units.literal: We arm and make ready at once."

units.zh: 使緭詐爲蕭寶夤書，以示僚佐。
units.en: He had Wei forge a letter as from Xiao Baoyin and show the staff.
units.literal: He had Wei forge a letter in Xiao Baoyin's name and show it to his staff.

units.zh: 於廳事前爲壇，殺牲以盟。
units.en: Before the hall he built an altar and slaughtered victims for the oath.
units.literal: Before the hall he raised an altar and slew victims to swear the oath.

units.zh: 伯之先飲，長史已下次第歃血。
units.en: Bozhi drank first; the chief clerk and the rest pledged in turn.
units.literal: Bozhi drank first; the chief clerk and those below took the blood in order.

units.zh: 緭說伯之曰：「今舉大事，宜引衆望，程元沖不與人同心；
units.en: Wei urged him, "A great rising needs men the troops trust. Cheng Yuanchong is not with us;
units.literal: Wei urged Bozhi, "In a great undertaking you should lean on men the host admires. Cheng Yuanchong does not share our heart;

units.zh: 臨川內史王觀，僧虔之孫，人身不惡，便可召爲長史，以代元沖。」
units.en: Linchuan interior administrator Wang Guan, Sengqian's grandson, is not ill-favored—summon him as chief clerk for Yuanchong."
units.literal: Linchuan interior administrator Wang Guan, grandson of Sengqian, is not ill-favored in person—call him in as chief clerk to replace Yuanchong."

units.zh: 伯之從之。
units.en: Bozhi agreed.
units.literal: Bozhi followed this.

units.zh: 仍以緭爲尋陽太守，加討逆將軍；
units.en: He made Wei Xunyang administrator and Suppresses-Rebellion general;
units.literal: He also made Wei administrator of Xunyang and gave him the added title Suppresses-Rebellion General;

units.zh: 永忠輔義將軍；
units.en: Yongzhong became Assists-the-Cause general;
units.literal: Yongzhong was made Assists-the-Cause General;

units.zh: 龍符爲豫州刺史，率五百人守大雷。
units.en: Longfu became Yuzhou inspector with five hundred men to hold Dalei.
units.literal: Longfu was made inspector of Yuzhou and led five hundred men to hold Dalei.

units.zh: 大雷戍主沈慧休，鎮南參軍李延伯。
units.en: Dalei was held by Shen Huixiu; Li Yanbo was Pacifies-the-South staff officer.
units.literal: Dalei garrison commander Shen Huixiu and Pacifies-the-South staff officer Li Yanbo.

units.zh: 又遣鄉人孫鄰、李景受龍符節度，鄰爲徐州，景爲郢州。
units.en: He sent townsman Sun Lin and Li Jing under Longfu—Lin for Xuzhou, Jing for Yingzhou.
units.literal: He also sent his townsman Sun Lin and Li Jing under Longfu's command—Lin for Xuzhou, Jing for Yingzhou.

units.zh: 豫章太守鄭伯倫起郡兵距守。
units.en: Yuzhang administrator Zheng Bolun raised commandery forces to resist.
units.literal: Yuzhang administrator Zheng Bolun raised the commandery troops to hold him off.

units.zh: 程元沖旣失職，於家合率數百人，使伯之典籤呂孝通、戴元則爲內應。
units.en: Yuanchong, out of office, gathered hundreds at home and set Bozhi's recorders Lü Xiaotong and Dai Yuanze within.
units.literal: Yuanchong, having lost his post, gathered several hundred men at home and had Bozhi's recorders Lü Xiaotong and Dai Yuanze act as inside agents.

units.zh: 伯之每旦常作伎，日晡輒臥，左右仗身皆休息。
units.en: Each dawn Bozhi held his entertainments; by afternoon he slept and his guards rested.
units.literal: Each morning Bozhi would perform his entertainments; by late afternoon he would lie down and his bodyguards all rested.

units.zh: 元沖因其解弛，從北門入，徑至廳事前。
units.en: Yuanchong used the slack to enter the north gate and reach the hall.
units.literal: Yuanchong used that slack hour to enter by the north gate and go straight to the hall.

units.zh: 伯之聞叫聲，自率出蕩，元沖力不能敵，走逃廬山。
units.en: Hearing the clamor, Bozhi rushed out himself; Yuanchong could not stand and fled to Mount Lu.
units.literal: Hearing the outcry, Bozhi himself rushed out to fight; Yuanchong could not hold and fled to Mount Lu.

units.zh: 初，元沖起兵，要尋陽張孝季，孝季從之。
units.en: When Yuanchong first rose he called on Zhang Xiaoji of Xunyang; Xiaoji came.
units.literal: Earlier, when Yuanchong raised troops he had asked Xunyang's Zhang Xiaoji to join; Xiaoji followed him.

units.zh: 旣敗，伯之追孝季不得，得其母郎氏，蠟灌殺之。
units.en: Defeated, he could not catch Xiaoji; he took Xiaoji's mother Lady Lang and killed her with molten wax.
units.literal: After defeat Bozhi could not catch Xiaoji; he seized Xiaoji's mother, Lady Lang, and killed her by wax infusion.

units.zh: 遣信還都報虎牙兄弟，虎牙等走盱眙，盱眙人徐安、莊興紹、張顯明邀擊之，不能禁，反見殺。
units.en: He sent word to his sons at the capital; Huya and his brothers fled to Xuyi, where Xu An, Zhuang Xingshao, and Zhang Xianming ambushed them—failed to stop them and were killed instead.
units.literal: He sent word back to the capital to his sons Huya and the rest; Huya and his brothers fled to Xuyi, where Xuyi men Xu An, Zhuang Xingshao, and Zhang Xianming waylaid them—could not hold them, and were themselves killed.

units.zh: 高祖遣王茂討伯之。
units.en: Gaozu sent Wang Mao to crush Bozhi.
units.literal: Gaozu sent Wang Mao against Bozhi.

units.zh: 伯之聞茂來，謂緭等曰：「王觀旣不就命，鄭伯倫又不肯從，便應空手受困。
units.en: When he heard Mao was coming he told Wei, "Wang Guan would not come; Zheng Bolun would not follow—we are trapped with empty hands.
units.literal: Hearing Mao was coming, Bozhi told Wei and the rest, "Wang Guan would not take the post; Zheng Bolun would not follow—so we should be trapped empty-handed.

units.zh: 今先平豫章，開通南路，多發丁力，益運資糧，然後席捲北向，以撲饑疲之衆，不憂不濟也。」
units.en: Take Yuzhang first, open the south road, levy labor and grain, then sweep north against starving troops—how could we fail?"
units.literal: First pacify Yuzhang, open the southern road, levy many laborers, and haul more grain; then roll north in one sweep against starving, weary troops—how could we fail?"

units.zh: 乃留鄉人唐蓋人守城，遂相率趣豫章。
units.en: He left townsman Tang Gairen in the city and marched on Yuzhang.
units.literal: He left his townsman Tang Gairen to hold the city and led his men toward Yuzhang.

units.zh: 太守鄭伯倫堅守，伯之攻之不能下。
units.en: Zheng Bolun held fast; Bozhi could not break the city.
units.literal: Administrator Zheng Bolun held firm; Bozhi could not take it.

units.zh: 王茂前軍旣至，伯之表裏受敵，乃敗走，間道亡命出江北，與子虎牙及褚緭俱入魏。
units.en: Mao's vanguard came; caught between two fires, Bozhi fled by hidden paths north of the river and entered Wei with Huya and Chu Wei.
units.literal: Wang Mao's vanguard arrived; caught front and rear, Bozhi was beaten and fled, stole out by bypaths north of the river, and with his son Huya and Chu Wei entered Wei together.

units.zh: 魏以伯之爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督淮南諸軍事、平南將軍、光祿大夫、曲江縣侯。
units.en: Wei gave him the staff, made him irregular attendant, overseer of Huainan armies, Pacifies-the-South general, grand master of splendid happiness, and marquis of Qujiang.
units.literal: Wei made him bearer of the staff, irregular attendant, overseer of the Huainan armies, Pacifies-the-South General, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Marquis of Qujiang.

units.zh: 天監四年，詔太尉、臨川王宏率衆軍北討，宏命記室丘遲私與伯之書曰：
units.en: In Tianjian year four an edict sent Grand Marshal Linchuan Wang Hong north; Hong had his recorder Qiu Chi write Chen Bozhi privately, saying:
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianjian an edict had Grand Marshal Linchuan Wang Hong lead the armies north; Hong ordered his recorder Qiu Chi to send Chen Bozhi a private letter, saying:

units.zh: 陳將軍足下無恙，幸甚。
units.en: General Chen, I hope you are well. That itself is fortune enough.
units.literal: General Chen, I trust you are well—this is a great fortune.

units.zh: 將軍勇冠三軍，才爲世出。
units.en: Your courage tops the three armies; your gift stands above the age.
units.literal: Your valor crowns the three armies; your talent rises above this age.

units.zh: 棄䴏雀之小志，慕鴻鵠以高翔。
units.en: You left the sparrow's small hunger and sought the wild goose's high soar.
units.literal: You abandoned the sparrow's petty aim and aspired to the wild goose's lofty flight.

units.zh: 昔因機變化，遭逢明主，立功立事，開國承家，朱輪華轂，擁旄萬里，何其壯也！
units.en: Once you rode fortune to a bright lord, won merit, founded a house and a line—scarlet wheels, jeweled hubs, a command for ten thousand li: how splendid!
units.literal: Once, riding the turn of fortune, you met a bright lord, won merit and built your house, founded a state and carried on your line—scarlet wheels and jeweled hubs, a banner staff for ten thousand li: how grand it was!

units.zh: 如何一旦爲奔亡之虜，聞鳴鏑而股戰，對穹廬以屈膝，又何劣耶？
units.en: Then in one morning you were a runaway captive, shaking at whistling arrows, kneeling before felt tents—how fallen!
units.literal: How is it that in a single morning you became a fugitive captive, tremble at the whistle of arrows, and kneel before the nomad tent—how base by contrast!

units.zh: 尋君去就之際，非有他故，直以不能內審諸己，外受流言，沉迷猖蹷，以至於此。
units.en: Looking back, there was no other cause: you could not judge yourself within and drank in rumor without; lost in frenzy, you came here.
units.literal: When I weigh your going and staying, there was no other cause: you simply could not examine yourself within and without took in wandering talk; lost in riot and rashness, you came to this.

units.zh: 聖朝赦罪論功，棄瑕錄用，收赤心于天下，安反側於萬物，將軍之所知，非假僕一二談也。
units.en: The holy court forgives and rewards, overlooks flaws and employs the loyal, gathers hearts under heaven and stills the restless world—you know this; I need not say it twice.
units.literal: The holy court pardons crime and weighs merit, casts aside flaws and records the useful, gathers loyal hearts under heaven and steadies the rebellious among the ten thousand things—this you know yourself; I need not argue it twice.

units.zh: 朱鮪涉血於友于，張繡倳刃於愛子，漢主不以爲疑，魏君待之若舊。
units.en: Zhu Wei bloodied brotherhood; Zhang Xiu turned steel on his own son—yet the Han emperor did not doubt them, and the Wei ruler welcomed them as before.
units.literal: Zhu Wei shed blood among brothers; Zhang Xiu raised the blade against his beloved son—yet the Han lord did not doubt them, and the Wei lord received them as of old.

units.zh: 況將軍無昔人之罪，而勳重於當世。
units.en: How much more you, who have no such ancient guilt, while your service outweighs the men of this day!
units.literal: How much more for you, who bear no guilt of those ancients, while your merit outweighs the men of today!

units.zh: 夫迷塗知反，往哲是與；
units.en: To lose the way and turn back—the sages of old approved;
units.literal: To lose the road and know to turn back—the wise of old praised it;

units.zh: 不遠而復，先典攸高。
units.en: to return without wandering far—the classics exalt it.
units.literal: to return without going far—the canon holds it high.

units.zh: 主上屈法申恩，吞舟是漏。
units.en: Our lord bends law into mercy; even leviathans slip the net.
units.literal: Our lord bends the law to extend grace; even great fish may pass the net.

units.zh: 將軍松柏不剪，親戚安居；
units.en: Your pines and cypresses stand uncut; your kin live at ease;
units.literal: Your pine and cypress are not cut; your kin dwell in peace;

units.zh: 高臺未傾，愛妾尚在。
units.en: your tower has not toppled; your beloved is still there.
units.literal: your high tower has not fallen; your beloved concubine is still there.

units.zh: 悠悠爾心，亦何可述。
units.en: What your far-off heart holds—who could spell it out?
units.literal: What your distant heart holds—how could words tell it?

units.zh: 今功臣名將，雁行有序。
units.en: Now the great captains and ministers move in ordered ranks like geese in flight.
units.literal: Now meritorious ministers and famed generals march in ordered ranks like wild geese.

units.zh: 懷黃佩紫，贊帷幄之謀；
units.en: They wear purple sashes and gold seals and shape counsel in the tent;
units.literal: They clasp gold seals on yellow cords and counsel within the tent;

units.zh: 乘軺建節，奉疆埸之任。
units.en: they ride light carriages with staff and banner and bear the border's trust.
units.literal: they ride light carriages with staff and banner and bear the frontier's charge.

units.zh: 並刑馬作誓，傳之子孫。
units.en: All have sworn the horse-mouth oath and handed it to sons and grandsons.
units.literal: All have sworn oaths with blood on the horse's mouth and pass them to sons and grandsons.

units.zh: 將軍獨靦顏借命，驅馳異域，寧不哀哉！
units.en: You alone hide your face and cling to life, galloping in a strange land—does it not wring the heart?
units.literal: You alone hide your face and borrow life, driving hard in a foreign land—can this not grieve the heart?

units.zh: 夫以慕容超之強，身送東市；
units.en: Murong Chao was mighty, yet he walked to the eastern market himself;
units.literal: For all Murong Chao's strength, he was sent to the eastern market in his own person;

units.zh: 姚泓之盛，面縛西都。
units.en: Yao Hong flourished, yet he was bound and led to the western capital.
units.literal: for all Yao Hong's flourishing, he was bound and led to the western capital.

units.zh: 故知霜露所均，不育異類；
units.en: So where frost and dew fall alike, no alien breed is raised;
units.literal: Thus we know that where frost and dew fall alike, no alien breed is reared;

units.zh: 姬漢舊邦，無取雜種。
units.en: and in Ji and Han's old realm no mongrel stock is kept.
units.literal: in the old lands of Ji and Han no mongrel stock is taken in.

units.zh: 北虜僭盜中原，多歷年所，惡積禍盈，理至燋爛。
units.en: The northern usurpers have held the central plains for years; wickedness has piled high and ruin is ripe—they must burn to ash.
units.literal: The northern barbarians have usurped the central plains for many years; their wickedness has piled up and their doom is ripe—reason itself says they must burn to ash.

units.zh: 況偽孽昏狡，自相夷戮，部落攜離，酋豪猜貳，方當繫頸蠻邸，懸首藳街。
units.en: Their false seed is muddled and cunning, turning blades on one another; tribes split and chiefs doubt—soon they will be bound at the barbarian hall and heads hung on the reed street.
units.literal: How much more when their false brood is muddled and cunning, slaying one another, tribes pulling apart and chiefs doubting one another—soon they will be bound at the barbarian lodge and their heads hung on the reed street.

units.zh: 而將軍魚游於沸鼎之中，䴏巢於飛幕之上，不亦惑乎！
units.en: Yet you swim in a boiling cauldron and nest under a flying curtain—are you not lost?
units.literal: Yet you swim like a fish in a boiling cauldron and nest like a swallow under a flying curtain—are you not bewildered?

units.zh: 暮春三月，江南草長，雜花生樹，羣鸎亂飛。
units.en: Late spring, third month: southland grass runs long, flowers crowd the trees, orioles cry in confusion.
units.literal: Late spring, the third month: grass grows long in the southland; mixed flowers bloom on the trees and flocks of orioles fly in confusion.

units.zh: 見故國之旗鼓，感平生於疇日，撫弦登陴，豈不愴恨。
units.en: To see the banners of home, to feel a lifetime in a day, to touch the lute and climb the rampart—who would not grieve?
units.literal: To see the banners of the old country, to feel one's whole life in a single day, to touch the strings and climb the wall—how could there be no grief and rage?

units.zh: 所以廉公之思趙將，吳子之泣西河，人之情也。
units.en: So the Duke of Lian yearned for Zhao's general; Wu Qi wept for the western river—such is the human heart.
units.literal: Thus the Duke of Lian thought of Zhao's general; Wu Qi wept for the western river—such is human feeling.

units.zh: 將軍獨無情哉！
units.en: General, are you alone without feeling?
units.literal: General, are you alone without feeling?

units.zh: 想早勵良圖，自求多福。
units.en: I trust you will soon spur a worthy plan and win your own greater fortune.
units.literal: I trust you will soon spur a worthy plan and seek your own greater fortune.

units.zh: 伯之乃於壽陽擁衆八千歸。
units.en: Bozhi then at Shouyang led eight thousand men home in surrender.
units.literal: Bozhi then at Shouyang led a host of eight thousand in surrender.

units.zh: 虎牙爲魏人所殺。
units.en: Huya was killed by the Wei.
units.literal: Huya was killed by Wei men.

units.zh: 伯之旣至，以爲使持節、都督西豫州諸軍事、平北將軍、西豫州刺史，永新縣侯，邑千戶。
units.en: When Bozhi arrived he was made bearer of staff, area commander of Western Yuzhou, Pacification North general, and Western Yuzhou inspector, Marquis of Yongxin with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Bozhi arrived he was made Bearer of Staff, Area Commander of Western Yuzhou military affairs, Pacification North General, and Western Yuzhou Inspector, Marquis of Yongxin county, fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 未之任，復以爲通直散騎常侍、驍騎將軍，又爲太中大夫。
units.en: Before taking post he was again made through-passage scattered cavalry attendant, Valiant Cavalry general, and grand master for consulting the monarch.
units.literal: Before he took the post he was again made Regular Attendant-through-passage Scattered Cavalry Attendant, Valiant Cavalry General, and also Grand Master for Consulting the Monarch.

units.zh: 久之，卒於家。
units.en: After a long while he died at home.
units.literal: After a long while he died at home.

units.zh: 其子猶有在魏者。
units.en: Some of his sons were still in Wei.
units.literal: Some of his sons were still in Wei.

units.zh: 褚緭在魏，魏人欲擢用之。
units.en: Chu Wei was in Wei, and the Wei court wished to promote and employ him.
units.literal: Chu Wei was in Wei; the Wei wished to promote and employ him.

units.zh: 魏元會，緭戲爲詩曰：「帽上著籠冠，袴上著朱衣，不知是今是，不知非昔非。」
units.en: At the Wei New Year assembly Chu jested in verse: "A cage-crown on his hat, vermilion robes on his trousers—he cannot tell now from then, nor then from now."
units.literal: At the Wei new year's court assembly Chu jested in verse, saying: "Upon his hat he set a cage-crown; upon his trousers he wore vermilion robes—not knowing whether this is now, not knowing whether that was not then."

units.zh: 魏人怒，出爲始平太守。
units.en: The Wei were enraged and posted him as administrator of Shiping.
units.literal: The Wei were enraged and sent him out as Administrator of Shiping.

units.zh: 日日行獵，墮馬死。
units.en: He hunted every day and died in a fall from his horse.
units.literal: He went hunting daily and died falling from his horse.

units.zh: 史臣曰：劉季連之文吏小節，而不能以自保全，習亂然也。
units.en: The historian writes: Liu Lijian had a literary man's polish, yet could not save himself—as habit in troubled times will do.
units.literal: The historian says: Liu Lijian had the small refinements of a literary official, yet could not preserve himself—such is growing accustomed to disorder.

units.zh: 陳伯之小人而乘君子之器，羣盜又誣而奪之，安能長久矣。
units.en: Chen Bozhi was a petty man wielding a gentleman's post; the robber bands slandered and tore it from him—how could he endure?
units.literal: Chen Bozhi was a petty man who took up the vessel of a gentleman; the bandit mob further slandered and seized it from him—how could it last long?

units.zh: 秋七月，庚戌，以中書郎蕭遙欣爲兖州刺史，東莞太守臧靈智爲交州刺史。
units.en: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: Xiao Yaoxin, secretariat gentleman, took Yanzhou; Zang Lingzhi, administrator of Dongguan, took Jiaozhou.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: Secretariat Gentleman Xiao Yaoxin was made inspector of Yanzhou; Administrator of Dongguan Zang Lingzhi was made inspector of Jiaozhou.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，進號輔國將軍，仍爲驍騎將軍，尋除寧蜀太守，與益州刺史鄧元起西上襲劉季連，行至公安，道病卒，贈衛尉卿。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ai was advanced to General Who Assists the State, then kept as General of Valiant Cavalry, made administrator of Ning Shu, and with Yizhou inspector Deng Yuanqi went west against Liu Jilian; at Gong'an he died on the road and was posthumously made Minister of the Guard.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ai's rank was advanced to General Who Assists the State; he remained General of Valiant Cavalry, was soon made Administrator of Ning Shu, and with Yizhou Inspector Deng Yuanqi went west to attack Liu Jilian; on reaching Gong'an he died of illness on the road and was posthumously made Minister of the Guard.

units.zh: 元康曰：「嘗讀《崔琰傳》，追恨魏武不弘。
units.en: Yuankang said, "I once read the biography of Cui Yan and regretted that Wei Wu was not magnanimous.
units.literal: Yuankang said: "I once read the biography of Cui Yan and regretted that Wei Wu was not magnanimous.

units.zh: 遣平西將軍王廣之誅南兖州刺史安陸王子敬。
units.en: Wang Guangzhi, pacifying-west general, was sent to kill Xiao Zijing, prince of Anlu and inspector of South Yanzhou.
units.literal: Pacifying-West General Wang Guangzhi was sent to execute Inspector of South Yanzhou Prince Zijing of Anlu.
